# CANDIDATE: MIDDAY_RIBBON_COMPRESSION_BREAKOUT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

During the lunch lull (12:00-13:45 ET), the EMA ribbon often contracts as market participation decreases. A breakout above the contracted ribbon with a volume surge signals the resumption of the morning trend, offering a high-probability entry for trend continuation.

## Mechanism

Between 12:00 and 13:45 ET, calculate ribbon width as (fastest EMA - slowest EMA) / price. If ribbon width remains below 0.002 for 5 consecutive minutes, and the price closes above the highest EMA in the ribbon with volume exceeding 2× the average volume of the prior 20 minutes, enter long at that close. Exit: chart-stop at the lowest EMA of the ribbon, TP1 at 2R (risk-reward), and a runner position managed by a chandelier trail (ATR×3).
